- By product (Measured; top examples)

Interpretation and labels
- Lower ad spend on Meta/Google is a direct measured contributor to lower channel sales (Measured). Tag: Derived (spend drop → less attributed traffic).  
- Large falls concentrated in a few high-volume products (Pawveralls lines, SnugSole) explain most of the net-sales decline (Measured). Tag: Measured.  
- Some products grew (e.g., Play Scratch Lounge) partially offsetting the loss — suggests mix shift rather than uniform demand collapse (Measured). Tag: Measured.  
- Hypothesis: ad reallocation or paused campaigns on Meta/Google caused the product-level losses; campaign-level changes would confirm. Tag: Hypothesis.
